description: The button on a customer's Contacts card that links a contact to the customer.
The button in the Add contact dialog that links the contact to the customer.
The field in the Add contact dialog where you find an existing contact or start a new one.
The name field of the customer form. For a business it looks the name up in the Brønnøysund register.
The button that saves the customer form.
The choice between a business and a private person in the new customer form.
The button above the customer list that opens the form for a new customer.
The button on a metering point's Supply periods card that starts a supply period for a customer.
The customer field of the supply period dialog.
The button in the supply period dialog that saves the supply period.
The date the supply period starts, in the supply period dialog.
The street address field in the new metering point form; the postal code, city and country follow it.
The GSRN field, the metering point's 18-digit number, in the new metering point form.
The meter number field in the new metering point form.
The button that saves the metering point form.
The button above the metering point list that opens the form for a new metering point.
The button on a travel claim that submits it for approval.
The description field of the expense form.
The button that saves the expense as a draft, from where it can be submitted.
The button on My expenses that opens the form for a new expense.
The button on My expenses that opens the form for a new travel claim.
The button on the Counts page that opens a stock count of a site, or of a location and everything below it.
The field at the top of the Inventory home page: scan or type a location code, a label, a SKU or a barcode and press Enter to open it.
The button on the Inventory home page that opens a new stock adjustment, to correct what lies on a location with a reason.
The button on the Inventory home page that opens a new move, to move stock between two locations of one site.
The button on the Inventory home page that opens a new goods receipt, to receive items onto a location.
The button on the Inventory home page that opens the form for a new site, a warehouse or a store.
The field on the Import page where the CSV of opening balances — location, sku and quantity — is chosen before a dry run.
The button on a site's page that creates a grid of locations at once, such as aisles, racks and shelves.
The button on a site's page that opens the form for a new location directly under the site.
The button on a site's page that downloads a PDF of location labels, for every location in the site or the ones chosen, on an Avery L7160 or L7163 sheet.
The button below a draft invoice's lines that adds an empty line.
The button that issues a saved draft invoice and gives it its number.
The button that saves changes to a draft invoice.
The button in the new invoice dialog that creates the draft and opens it.
The customer picker of the new invoice dialog.
The button above the invoice list that starts a new invoice.
On the customer's Orders tab, starts a new order for this customer.
On the customer's Orders tab, starts a new quote for this customer.
Creates the draft order for the picked customer and opens its editor.
The customer picker a new order starts from.
Creates the draft quote for the picked customer and opens its editor.
The customer picker a new quote starts from.
Confirms a draft order: freezes its prices and customer, and stores the order confirmation.
Saves an order's header and lines; a confirmed order takes changes to what is not delivered or invoiced.
The button above the order list that starts a new order.
Records that the customer accepted a sent quote and makes an order of it.
The accept dialog: the optional lines the customer took, and whether a draft or a confirmed order is made.
Saves a draft quote's header and lines; the server prices the lines and computes the totals.
Opens the send dialog that e-mails the quote's PDF to the customer and moves it to sent.
The button above the quote list that starts a new quote.
Saves the Orders settings: number series, validity, payment terms, the send channel and the mail texts.
Starts a new quote template with texts and lines a quote can start from.
The project code field; a suggestion is offered for it.
The customer picker of the project form; an internal project has no customer.
The name field of the project form.
The button that saves the project form.
The button above the project list that opens the form for a new project.
The button on the Day page that opens the form for a new time entry.
The hours field of the time entry form; it is worked out from the start and end time when both are filled in.
The project field of the time entry form.
The button that saves the time entry.
The button on My week that submits the week for approval.
